title: Money mule request
summary: A person asks you to receive, move, or withdraw money on someone else's behalf.
scenario: The request may use a job, romance, friendship, or investment explanation to hide the payment origin.
warning_signs: Instructions to use your own account
Pressure to forward money quickly or keep it secret
safe_actions: Do not receive or forward unfamiliar funds
Stop contact and ask your bank or payment provider for guidance
Keep the messages and transaction details
recovery_guidance: Do not spend or return funds based only on the sender's instructions
Contact the provider through a known route and follow its guidance
reporting_guidance: Use an independently checked reporting destination
prevention_tips: Your account should not be used as an intermediary for strangers
A commission does not make an unusual transfer safe
false_positive_notes: Legitimate businesses use payment intermediaries, but the organization, purpose, and account controls must be independently verified.
